purpose: Acceptance audit for people who may benefit from or be burdened by civic AI. These are design-test groups, not marketing personas and not claims about completed consultation.
cross_cutting_rule: A scenario is not mature if any relevant acceptance group loses a necessary ordinary-service path, faces a materially higher burden without justification, cannot identify human help, or cannot refuse/leave the AI interaction where refusal should be available.

benefit_test: daily tasks become easier without losing familiar ordinary routes
public space remains usable without participation in AI pilots
burden_risks: service churn from frequent interface changes

benefit_test: complete key tasks without independent smartphone/AI operation
reach a person without excessive steps or waiting

groups.name_zh: 残障人士与行动/感知受限者
benefit_test: route and service completion with physical accessibility intact
AI adds optional information rather than replacing accessible infrastructure
caregiver can complete journey without child profiling
open tools and reproducible civic research
legitimate research access without bypassing public rules
burden_risks: false assumption that research purpose overrides resident rights

benefit_test: test and translation pathways are understandable and not dependent on a single vendor gatekeeper
public rules are stable enough for innovation
rest, routing and work support improve without invasive surveillance
burden_risks: robot deployment shifting risk/work without support

benefit_test: understand core services and heritage without local app/account
multilingual help does not invent historical facts
required_fallback: source-indexed heritage information and human help

groups.name_zh: 无智能手机、无账号或主动拒绝AI的人
groups.name_en: People without smartphones/accounts or who actively decline AI
benefit_test: complete every necessary public task without mandatory AI participation
refusal does not create discriminatory service degradation

next_validation: Run scenario-by-scenario task tests with relevant groups after spatial and operational baselines are verified; record burden, failure and stop decisions in Public Receipts.
